body: Minimal flat-vector loading indicator on a transparent background, locked front view. Three cobalt-blue rounded dots sit in one row. The left dot hops, then the center, then the right, and all three settle into the exact starting alignment on the final frame. Sharp vector edges, solid color, no text.
